verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a first-party API for programmatic access to the platform, with official client libraries, a Postman collection, and feature-specific APIs such as the evaluations API. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI-to-API parity, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the candidate paths. missing for 10: explicit statement or demonstration of UI/API feature parity, endpoint coverage across all UI features, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the Datadog API to access the Datadog platform programmatically.
Select one of our official [client libraries](/extend/community/libraries/) languages in each endpoint to see code examples from that library.
You can use the evaluations API provided by Agent Observability to send evaluations associated with spans, traces, or sessions to Datadog.
